summary: Re-ran public backend regression checks and mobile Expo login validation. All 8 backend boundary checks passed; Indonesian login rendered with google-login-button. Authenticated positive flows remain unverified because no Google test account is available.

integration_issues.issue: Backend PATCH /api/users/{id}/status exists, but AccessPage only displays enabled status and provides no activate/deactivate control, so the requested user status flow is not available in the UI.

action_items: Add an authenticated Access User activate/deactivate action wired to PATCH /api/users/{id}/status.
Provide a Google OAuth test account to verify authenticated dashboard, RBAC, AI toggles, user CRUD, persistence after refresh, and drawer navigation.
Add data-testid attributes to Access User inputs and role/status controls for reliable mobile regression tests.
critical_code_review_comments: AccessPage has no user status mutation control despite the backend endpoint being implemented.
SimplePage catches API errors in useEffect and does not render an error state, leaving server/country/interrogation failures silent.
Authenticated positive paths were not claimed because test_credentials.md confirms no Google test account is available.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview: https://ai-management-hub-8.preview.emergentagent.com. Login UI loaded at 375x667 and Google button was present. Browser error scan was not completed because the test script's JavaScript selector string was malformed; this is a test-script issue, not an app finding.
rca_of_issue: Static review of ControlCenter.tsx shows AccessPage renders Status but never calls the available /users/{user_id}/status endpoint. The backend route is present and role-protected, so the missing capability is frontend wiring/UI rather than an API route failure.
